title: Board Window Canvas Full Height
description: Board canvas inside Golden Layout UI windows did not stretch to full pane height because Window was not a flex container while UICanvas portal wrapper used flex-1. Fix Window root to flex column + min-h-0 so BoardCanvas height:100% resolves.
summary: Golden Layout portals wrap window content in a flex-1 column shell, but Window was only `relative h-full` (not a flex container), so flex-1 never expanded and BoardCanvas stayed content-height. Window root is now `flex flex-col min-h-0` so the portal shell fills the pane and the board canvas resizes to the full UI window height.
